lee (AE): Heads-up: Nebula (prospect) wants a 3-week POC. Primary asks: EU-only residency, customer-managed KMS preferred, target p95 <= 250ms for ~400-token responses, typical load ~50 RPS with 200 RPS bursts. They also want clear pass/fail criteria for quality + perf. Can we sketch a recommended path and a short customer runbook they can run themselves? cc @sasha @omar @tess

sasha (Solutions Eng): Quick read: model requested = LLaMA-style 33B or 13B quant. Use cases = retrieval-augmented Q&A + short summarization. My lean: do a hybrid canary flow: start Hosted eu-west-1 to validate prompts & evals (fast), then bring up a Dedicated pool for load. If they insist on CMK and VPC from day 0 -> Private which adds ~1 week setup.

omar (Infra): From infra perspective, to hit p95 250ms at 50RPS with 400-token tails we need either: 1) Dedicated pool sized for steady state (N x a10g) or 2) Hosted with aggressive autoscale + higher cost. For 200RPS burst, plan burst nodes or overflow to a lower-cost Hosted fallback. We should define an explicit fallback routing policy so they know behavior during saturation.

tess (Security): Security checklist items I need answered to finalize questionnaire: Do they require monthly key rotation? Do logs need to be forwarded to their SIEM (SPLUNK/Datadog)? Any PII masking rules? We can support CMKs via customer KMS in eu-west-1; Private gives more control but needs network ops approval. We'll prepare SOC2 attestation and a short note on encryption and key ownership.

lee (AE): They asked for CMK in eu-west-1 and Splunk forwarding. No HIPAA. PII: basic masking acceptable, but they want the ability to redact full user identifiers on ingest.

sasha (Solutions Eng): Proposed acceptance criteria (suggested):
- Functional quality: run 150 labeled prompts covering retrieval Q&A, single-turn summarization, and instruction-following. Metrics: BLEU not great for chat; use semantic similarity + exact-match when applicable. Target: >= 0.88 semantic-similarity (embedding cosine) and >= 85% exact/partial match on factual answers.
- Performance: p95 latency <= 250ms for 400-token responses under 50 RPS steady; under simulated 200RPS burst p95 <= 600ms. Availability >= 99.5% during POC window.
- Resource/Cost: show both 13B quant vs 33/70B cost per 1M tokens/day. Provide rough day-rate for Dedicated nodes and Hosted per-token estimate.
- Security: CMK ownership confirmed + Splunk log sink + EU-only log residency. Questionnaire answered and SOC2 report provided.

omar (Infra): Minimal runbook snippets for customer-run tests:
```
# quick hosted trial (no infra req)
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $REPO_KEY" -d '{"model":"redwood-13b-quant","prompt":"<test prompt>","max_tokens":400}'

# start k6 burst sim (from their side)
k6 run --vus 200 --duration 3m burst_test.js

# simple wrk steady-state (50 RPS target)
wkr --rate 50 --duration 5m -t4 -c50 https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
Include these in the customer handout.

deploy-bot: Runbook link created: https://internal.redwood/sops/pocs/nebula-poc-runbook. Contains deploy steps, sample eval harness, monitoring dashboard, and routing policy examples. :sparkles:

tess (Security): I'll draft the questionnaire answers. Key points I'll assert: SOC2 Type II available; TLS + AES-256 at-rest; CMK supported via AWS KMS (eu-west-1); audit logs retained 365 days in EU-only storage. I'll also list required artifact exchange for Nebula (contact/email) so we can share SOC2 PDF.

sasha (Solutions Eng): Cost sketch (very rough, to be refined):
- Hosted 13B-quant: approx $Y per 1M tokens (token pricing), minimal infra ops. Fastest path: provision in hours.
- Dedicated 13B-quant (2 x a10g steady): infra ~$Z/day, better p95 control.
- 33/70B increase compute by ~2x-4x depending on quantization. I'll put precise numbers in the proposal doc.

lee (AE): Timeline proposal (customer wants 3 weeks):
- Week 0 (kick): contract + security paperwork kickoff. Provision Hosted tenant in eu-west-1 same day.
- Week 1: functional evals & prompt tuning (150 prompts, iterate).
- Week 2: Dedicated provision + load tests (or Private setup if required).
- Week 3: acceptance tests, final report, next-steps.
If Nebula wants CMK + VPC from day 0, insert Private setup step and push final by 1 week.

omar (Infra): Routing policy we recommend: primary = Dedicated pool (eu-west-1); overflow = Hosted eu-west-1 low-cost instance type; fallback = throttled errors with clear header telling client to retry after Xs. We'll attach sample policy config to runbook.

sasha (Solutions Eng): Action items:
- sasha: prepare cost delta table (13B/33B/70B; hosted vs dedicated) + per-1M token examples (deliver EOD).
- omar: add runbook snippets + dedicated config + routing policy into runbook (today).
- tess: complete questionnaire draft + SOC2 artifact list + KMS options (tomorrow).
- lee: coordinate customer kickoff and share runbook link + invite infosec.

lee (AE): Thanks all. I'll propose: "Fast path: Hosted eu-west-1 for week 1 (quality), Dedicated eu-west-1 for week 2 (SLA), Optional Private/VPC if they require CMK+VPC (adds week)." Will flag explicit fallback behaviour on the customer call. :+1:
